format: first single Mathnasium learning center (leased, 1,200-1,600 sq ft)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of your first Mathnasium franchise ranges from $127,316 to $165,846. This includes $51,266 to $52,596 that must be paid to the franchisor or its affiliate.

fee.quote: The initial franchise fee is $49,000 for your first franchise. You must pay the entire fee when you sign the Franchise Agreement.
fee.note: Additional franchise or eligible Center Director: $26,500 ($15,000 may be financed at 10%). Veterans/active duty and qualifying educators: 25% off the first center fee. Transferee: $7,000. Additional Center Incentive (existing franchisee, same territory, signed by December 31, 2026): fee waived plus up to $1,500/month royalty waived for 12 months.

royalty.flat: Beginning in the 24th month of operation of the Center, the greater of (i) the 10% monthly royalty or (ii) $1,500. Plus Base Royalty $650 per month
royalty.quote: Monthly Royalty Initially, 10% of your monthly Gross Receipts from all sources as a result of operating your Center. Beginning in the 24th month of operation of the Center, the greater of (i) the 10% monthly royalty or (ii) $1,500. ... Base Royalty $650 per month

adFund.quote: Monthly Marketing Fee $250 plus 2% of your monthly Gross Receipts (see Note 4) from all sources as a result of operating your Center.
adFund.note: Marketing fee is $250 per month plus 2%. Separate Digital and Local Marketing Fee of a minimum $1,000 per month paid to franchisor, credited against the local advertising requirement of at least $6,000 every 3 consecutive months. Pre-opening advertising $5,500.

otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $266 per month per Mathnasium Center

Unaudited franchisee-reported data. Year-over-year average growth 13.3%.

special: Royalty is 10% of Gross Receipts with a $1,500 monthly minimum from month 24, plus a fixed $650 monthly base royalty, plus marketing fee $250 + 2%, plus a $1,000 minimum monthly digital/local marketing fee and $266 tech fee: fixed fees weigh heavily on a small center (average Gross Receipts $384,874; Item 19 shows royalties and marketing fees at 17.4% of Gross Receipts). Fixed dollar fees can rise each year by the greater of 3% or CPI.
